title: Rethinking Successive Rejects Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.22051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the best-arm identification problem, an algorithm adaptively selects arms to find the arm of the largest mean reward. Successive Rejects (SR) is a simple fixed-budget best-arm identification algorithm that eliminates one candidate arm at each phase. At first glance, SR seems to have limited adaptivity, since it follows predetermined phase lengths. However, for Gaussian arms with common variance, SR's worst-instance error exponent normalized by the popular complexity measure $H_1(P)$ is optimal up to a constant factor, which partly explains why SR's performance is competitive compared with state-of-the-art adaptive sampling algorithms. In this paper, we extend the framework of SR by optimizing its predefined schedule of phase lengths. We formulate phase-schedule design as an optimization problem for the normalized error exponent. Then, we introduce a version of SR with the optimized schedule, which we call $H_1$-balanced Successive R

translated_title: 重新思考连续拒绝算法
translated_abstract: 在最优臂识别问题中，算法通过自适应地选择各个臂来找到平均奖励最大的臂。连续拒绝算法是一种简单的固定预算最优臂识别算法，它在每个阶段淘汰一个候选臂。乍一看，SR 似乎自适应能力有限，因为它遵循预先确定的阶段长度。然而，对于具有共同方差的高斯臂，SR 以流行的复杂度度量 H1(P) 归一化后的最坏情况误差指数在常数因子范围内是最优的，这部分解释了为什么 SR 的性能与最先进的自适应采样算法相比具有竞争力。在本文中，我们通过优化 SR 预先定义的阶段长度调度来扩展其框架。我们将阶段调度设计表述为一个关于归一化误差指数的优化问题。然后，我们引入了一种具有优化调度的 SR 版本，我们称之为 H1-平衡连续拒绝算法。
tldr: 本文通过将 SR 算法的阶段长度调度设计表述为归一化误差指数的优化问题，提出了 H1-平衡连续拒绝算法，从而在固定预算最优臂识别中提升了 SR 算法的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Successive Rejects algorithm by formulating its phase-length schedule design as an optimization problem for the normalized error exponent, introducing the H1-balanced SR algorithm for fixed-budget best-arm identification.
